Mortgaging is not an option. I have no liquidity crisis and would only weaken my light blue path.

I am now weighing whether to trade or simply end the turn.

A better orange monopoly would require p1 and p4, so it is too expensive. Three houses on the light blue set are strong enough. Oriental Avenue would rent $30 with one house and $270 with three.

Three houses on the light blue set would generate $840 in combined rent. The $450 house cost is efficient. I should not trade away either property.

I will end the turn. I have no trade that can acquire Oriental Avenue, since it is still unowned by the bank.

I have only $35 left after buying Oriental Avenue. That is too little to build three houses on the light blue set. An orange monopoly would cost $900 in house upgrades, which I cannot afford. The light blue set remains the only viable path.
